name: Belize
about: Hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: The Great Blue Hole and the Belize Barrier Reef — the largest in the Northern Hemisphere — make this the Caribbean's premier diving destination, with English as the official language and jungle ruins (Caracol, Xunantunich) a short trip inland.
costOverview: Belize stays affordable on land — a real plate of rice and beans runs just a few dollars — but the water taxis connecting the cayes add up fast for island-hopping itineraries.

costItems.label: Rice and beans plate, local spot

specialSeasons.text: Whale sharks gather near Gladden Spit to spawn alongside the snapper aggregation — a reliable, seasonal big-animal dive.
Peak hurricane season — real storm risk, though the barrier reef offers some shelter compared to open Caribbean coasts.
